scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute in checker is computationally prohibitive; structural trends (ordering, existence, reentrance) derived from the paper's phase diagrams provide a faithful verification of correct reproduction.

schema.description: kappa1: float, theta: float, rho_star: float, transition_type: string ('NuNb' or 'nonuniform')

outputs.description: Computed spinodal densities for the requested grid of (κ1, θ).

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker re-implements the same DFT and bifurcation analysis and compares the agent's reported rho_star values against its own recomputed values with a relative tolerance; qualitative trends are also verified.

steps.description: Spinodal points structural and trend verification

structural_checks.description: All required (kappa1, theta) grid points are present (at least one row per combination).
For kappa1=5, NuNb rows exist only for theta ≤ -0.6 (i.e., -1.0, -0.8, -0.6) and are absent for theta ≥ -0.4.
For kappa1=10, NuNb rows exist at theta = -1.0, -0.5, 0.0 and are absent at theta ≥ 0.2.
For kappa1=20, a NuNb row exists at theta = 0.0 and is absent at theta = 1.0.
For kappa1=55, at theta = 1.0 there are exactly two rows with transition_type='NuNb' (reentrant behavior).
For kappa1=70, a NuNb row exists for every theta value in the grid (θ from -1.0 to 1.0).
For any (kappa1, theta) with both a NuNb and a nonuniform row, rho_star(NuNb) < rho_star(nonuniform).
All rho_star values are positive and ≤ 1000 (sanity range).

hidden_assets.purpose: Structural trend descriptions derived from the paper's phase diagrams (Figs. 3, 4 and associated text).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures and discussion: existence/absence regions of NuNb phase, reentrance, and density gap.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually transcribed from the paper's qualitative statements and figure observations into boolean trend predicates.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These trends are the exact physical predictions of the paper; a correct reproduction must exhibit them. No fabricated numeric gold is used.
